column4: Pothuwatawana  Maha  Viharaya  Foundation
(Incorporation)
The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column3: constituted are hereby declared to be :—

column4: to provide assistance to improve dhamma education,
knowledge,  attitudes,  skills  of  Buddhists  and  their
children  by  initiation,  continuation  and  promotion
of training courses on Theravada Buddhism;
to  take  action  to  strengthen  reconciliation  among
each other by creation of friendship, goodwill, peace,
understanding  and  co-operation  among  ethnic  and
religious groups since this is an area with multi ethnic
and multi religious co-existence;
to  take  action  to  give  priority  to  activities  such  as
attracting  attendance  of  local  and  foreign  scholars
and devotees as well as followers with a view to further
promoting  Buddhist  doctrine  and  culture  by

conducting  Buddhist 
sermons,  conferences,
discussions  and  other  pertinent  programmes  and
facilitating them etc., since this is a Buddhist temple
fully  facilitated  and  situated  at  a  quiet  lication  in
close proximity to the main airport;
to  establish  a  just  society  through  organizing,
directing and practicing the sil campaign, meditation
programmes, and Bodhi Poojas;
to  take  necessary  action  to  eradicate  any  potential
threats to the Buddhism and the nation;
to train local and foreign missionaries from among
both laymen and clergymen; and
to do all such other acts and things as are necessary
for and incidential or conducive to the attainment of
the above objects.
